files.title: Students and parents
files.purpose: Admissions, student profiles and family contacts.
notes: Enter a student once. Capture enrollment details in the separate Enrollments file.
Enter each parent or guardian once, including parents of siblings. Use Relationships to link the same parent to multiple students.
Record at most one primary contact per student. Parent access and notification preferences must be confirmed with the family.
Document references identify records held by the college; attach documents separately through the future portal.

files.title: Fee structures and scholarships

Scholarship Schemes defines eligibility and award method. Student Scholarships records approved or pending awards.
An approved award is not a payment. Apply only the actual allocated scholarship amount against a charge in Charges and Payments.
Percentage values use whole percent units: enter 25 for 25 percent. Fixed awards use the Amount field.

files.title: Student charges and payments
files.purpose: Itemized academic, tuition, bus, hostel and other dues, scholarships and received payments.
notes: Charges has one row per student fee head and installment. Record academic, tuition, bus, hostel and other charges as separate rows.
Base amount is before reductions. Scholarship, discount, fine and tax are separate monetary amounts; blank optional amounts mean zero.
Calculated columns show gross charge before scholarship, net payable after scholarship, settled amount allocated and outstanding balance.
Only approved awards may reduce a charge. Use the Award code, not the scheme code, to link each scholarship application.
Record one row per received payment in Payments. Split a payment across fee heads using Allocations; never repeat the entire payment for each head.
Only allocations linked to settled payments count toward paid totals. A pending or failed payment does not reduce outstanding dues.
Historical receipts require both the payment and its allocations. Zero balances must reconcile with the college accounts records.

schema_projection_status: Expanded collection specification. Target names are planning hints, not implemented SQL column mappings.
validation_rules: Import by filename and data-tab name. Match exact row-6 visible headers, including required-field asterisks, to field keys. Ignore rows 1-5 and the Guide tab.
Skip fully blank input rows, including rows containing only calculated formulas. Ignore calculated columns and recompute their results on the server. Reject formulas in user input columns.

Require every mandatory field on populated records, including conditional requirements stated in each field description. Preserve identifier leading zeros and validate dates, enums, numeric ranges and Yes/No values.

Validate unique primary codes within and across uploads, and resolve exact cross-file codes against the reviewed batch or existing database records. Reject unknown references and cross-campus inconsistencies.
Employee category must match the Teachers or Staff profile. Reject duplicate employee profiles and cyclic reporting lines.
Enrollment course, curriculum, batch, section, year and semester must agree. Do not allow conflicting definitions for the same master code. Check subject prerequisites and curriculum semester bounds.

For percentage scholarships require award_percent and forbid fixed_award_amount; for fixed awards require fixed_award_amount and forbid award_percent. Check percentages, caps, eligible heads and courses, approval status and combination policy.

Fee lines have separate fee head and installment codes. Charge references, student course and currency must match; approved discounts cannot exceed base charges. Scholarship allocations must not exceed an approved award or make net payable negative.

Payments and charge allocations must have the same student and currency. Non-cash transactions require a reference. Settled payments require unique receipts and receipt dates. Allocation totals must not exceed the received payment or charge balance.
Transport stop route, academic year and rate dates must be consistent. Validate route capacity, at most one active regular allocation per student and date overlaps.
Hostel bed labels must be unique within the room and their count must equal capacity. Validate date overlaps, at most one active allocation per bed and student, and approved rate exceptions.
Validate all start/end dates and numeric thresholds. Timed events require start/end times and a valid timezone; all-day events use date boundaries. Expand recurring events into explicit occurrences.

Show a dry-run preview and row/column errors. Commit only after review, in a transaction with explicit create or update mode and idempotency. Preserve all collected fields through approved staging and schema migrations; never silently drop expanded fields.
